name: probe: how often do ability-gated animations actually appear in the splash attract loop, and what did the 10 players roll
description: Diagnostic, not an assertion. splash-random-abilities passed but needed ~36s of sampling to catch a single gated animation, which is far longer than a feed impression lasts. This samples a fixed 60s window and reports (a) each player's rolled loadout and (b) a compact histogram of ONLY the ability-gated animations plus the underlying event counts (shoot/dunk/block/steal) they piggyback on - so it is clear whether the limiting factor is the abilities or the sim's event rate.

steps.until: (() => { window.__samples++; document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^="splash-player-"]').forEach(n => { const a = n.getAttribute('data-anim') || 'idle'; window.__a[a] = (window.__a[a]||0)+1; }); return Date.now() - window.__t0 > 45000; })()

steps.expression: (() => { delete window.__a; delete window.__samples; delete window.__t0; return 'cleaned'; })()
